headline: Mod installs, smoother controls and new tools reach Development
summary: Development users can install mods with dependencies, automatic updates and rollback, and share their setup (#161); this had not yet been run on Windows, macOS or Android. Ratchet can run consistently on diagonal stick pushes, Windows sound gaps are addressed, and Pokitaru's underwater rooms are hidden correctly (#168, #188, #194). Contributors gain an Object Viewer, freecam and local lighting tools; experimental light authoring defaults off (#195, #196). The 138,618 added and 49,327 removed lines are dominated by the upstream RAC1 import in #160.
highlights: Mod SDK 1.11.0 was released for interface 1.11: mods get their own data folder and can identify the current save slot, checked on PAL and NTSC (#172).
Android gains Arm ASR on Qualcomm GPUs and graphics controls in the drawer; Windows fixes restore Orxon's barrier strands and Batalia debris colours (#165, #183, #171, #178).
Settings can add the launcher and artwork to Steam. Linux was tested; Windows and macOS need manual checks, and Flatpak Steam is refused (#184).
Co-op #166 remains a draft. Going Commando USA v1.01 port #191 builds and allows walking and jumping in most levels, but is not playable; ship inputs are incomplete and most menus untested.
Audio replacement tab #164 is open, not merged. Windows crash reports gain symbol checks and activity trails, and bake logs identify their builds (#175, #193, #197).
Enhanced-lighting issues #159 and #173 closed: the former reported a region limit, the latter a PAL level 11 bake failure. Vulkan handling and rendering tests also received fixes (#187, #198).
